title: On the Physical Properties of Gallium
version: Chemical News 34, 150, 6 October 1876, from Comptes Rendus; Wellcome Library public-domain scan
lineage: The retained English report attributes the prediction as 5.9 while the 1895 German reprint says approximately 6.0; these are separately reported values. This document does not say the discovery itself was guided by Mendeleev.

passages.note: Printed p. 150 / source PDF p. 156: the discoverer compares new gallium-density measurements with a prediction he attributes to Mendeleev.

file.method: Selected pages extracted without changing page content using pdfseparate/pdfunite; corresponding raster renders checked against the complete source. Source-page numbering counts the original PDF from one.
